business.name: Simon
business.tagline: Bespoke Ghanaian Fashion & Stem Supplements from SIMONS

content.heroSub: Premium made-to-measure Kente, corporate and traditional African wear, plus our own Stem Supplements to support a better daily diet. Proudly made in Ghana.
content.aboutFashion: Every outfit starts with you. We take your measurements, listen to your story and cut your fabric by hand, from rich Kente ceremonial wear to sharp corporate suits and everyday traditional styles.
content.aboutSupplements: Stem Supplements is our own dietary supplement, created to support a better daily diet. It is simple to add to your routine and available for delivery. Pay when it reaches you.
content.supplementNotice: Stem Supplements is a food and dietary supplement. It is not a medicine and is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease. It does not replace a balanced diet. Speak to your doctor or pharmacist if you are pregnant, nursing, on medication or have a health condition.
content.deliveryNote: Delivery fees depend on your location. We confirm the total on WhatsApp before sending.
